knownGaps: Formal IAU constellation boundary polygons are ingested for the first set (Ori, UMa, Cas, Sco); other constellations still use asterism presentation geometry.
Most nebula visuals are markers or color proxies; each texture needs a per-image license and credit audit.

Six first-set nebulae now have local CC BY 4.0 observation JPEGs with per-image reviews and complete credits. The other six remain catalog markers. The earlier in-memory-only acquisition receipt is preserved as historical evidence.
Bright-star RGB and stellar portrait palettes are presentation approximations. Gaia proximity or render-anchor identity alone does not establish a named-star photometric measurement.
Photosphere portraits are generated presentation models and must not be described as observation textures.
